description: This file defines the Interest class within the Goteo project, handling user interests management including retrieval, saving, removal, and sharing interests with other users. It extends a category model and interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations related to user interests.

classes.name: Interest
classes.description: A model class representing user interests, providing methods to retrieve, save, remove, and share interests among users. It inherits from Goteo\Model\Category.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves interests for a specific user from the database.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the interest as a string.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all available categories of interests, optionally filtered by user.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current interest for a user into the database.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an interest for a user from the database.

methods.name: share
methods.description: Finds and returns users who share interests with a given user, optionally filtered by interest category and limited by number.

methods.name: shareAll
methods.description: Retrieves all users who share a specific interest category.
